item.title: Storefront Brief issue 3: Brazil CADE deadline Monday, Epic says alt distribution is 9 steps
item.description: English issue: Brazil CADE required Apple to respond by 2026-08-24 to Epic's complaint — Epic says alternative distribution in Brazil is a 9-step install (EU ~6 steps). Apple Brazil pages still list 5% CTC on off-store digital goods. Not a new US IAP rate. GetAppNiche prepaid median $2.99. Operator intel, not legal advice.
